summary: The diff shows that ChatRoom.tsx has been modified to remove the MediaPicker component import and its trigger button, and the frontend-file-summaries.txt confirms that 'GIF/sticker MediaPicker has been removed while image upload, audio recording, video recording, and video upload features remain intact.' The MediaPicker.tsx file appears in the modified list but was not deleted (only 0 files removed). However, based on the ChatRoom.tsx content shown, there is no import of MediaPicker and no GIF/sticker button visible, satisfying the primary AC. The other media features (image, audio, video) remain present in the imports and state variables. REQ-1 appears substantially implemented.
